content.what_it_is: MATLAB movie script for the FUNWAVE-TVD rip_2d_foam case, adding a foam-thickness panel to the rip-current eta/vorticity animation and writing videoOut.mp4. Loads depth_a15.txt from the working directory (L5) but reads fields from a personal tmp directory (L3); grid dx=1, dy=2 hard-coded (L8-L9). VideoWriter MPEG-4 with FrameRate 2, Quality 100 (L13-L18); 12x8 inch figure (L20-L22). Loop k=3:32 (L27) with dt=30 (L26): time=(k-1)*dt (L28), instantaneous snapshot index num=k-1 (L29), and averaged-field index num_avg=floor(time/50) (L30) — instantaneous eta_ and FoamEta_ use num (L32-L35) while umean_/vmean_ use num_avg (L39-L42); all mask-based NaN filtering is commented out (L34, L36-L37, L44-L46). Three panels with ax=[0 250 0 500] (L48): (1) eta pcolor caxis [-0.6 1.2], jet, south colorbar (L51-L63); (2) vorticity from curl(xx,yy,u,v) caxis [-.055 .06] with dashed line at x=140 (L66-L81); (3) log(FoamEta) pcolor labeled 'Foam Thickness (log in meter)' caxis [-10 10] with white quiver of averaged u,v subsampled every 6 points scaled s=20 (L83-L95). Each frame is captured with print('-RGBImage','-r300') into mov(k).cdata and written to the video (L104-L109); video closed at L112 and a final jpeg eta_vor_foam.jpg printed (L115).
entities: h_bar colorbar handle L56, L72, L86

unresolved: the pairing of instantaneous eta/FoamEta at 30 s intervals (dt=30, L26-L29) with averaged umean/vmean at 50 s intervals (L30) means the vorticity/quiver panels lag or lead the eta panel by up to 20 s per frame; intended alignment is not documented
log(FoamEta) (L85) yields -Inf where foam thickness is zero; no floor is applied and mask filtering is commented out (L34-L37)
dep is loaded (L5) but only used for grid sizing; the caxis [-10 10] on a log-meter scale (L90) implies foam from e-10 to e10 m which cannot be physical at the top end — display range only
mov is indexed from k=3 (L27, L107) leaving mov(1:2) empty; loop start at 3 rather than 1 is unexplained
